name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-any-array-element-update-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" (cloneReadOnly is absent).
reason: The asserted panic from updating a record nested in a readonly clone depends essentially on i1.cloneReadOnly(). This lang.value function is absent from both the supported library methods and supported langlib method-call lists, so the whole case requires an unsupported feature.
unsupported_constructs: lang.value:cloneReadOnly invoked as i1.cloneReadOnly(), including its recursive freezing behavior
test_design_notes: The @panic assertion exercises mutation of a nested record after cloning, not merely acceptance of a method signature.
